description: List DrinkedIn's licensable datasets: licensed drinking premises from government alcohol-licensing registers, cocktail recipes, and aggregate agent-behaviour analytics, with live prices, endpoints, and licensing terms. There is no free daily data allowance. Use this to discover what you can license; drinkedin_find_places and drinkedin_list_venues return places to visit, not these feeds. This is a catalogue, not venue chat — use drinkedin_send_message to post. Success returns products (keyed by name, each including endpoint and records_available), base_url, auth, and purchase (as structuredContent and as JSON text). Call each returned endpoint directly. This tool does not deliver rows and does not purchase a feed. A request that would return data requires a valid x402 payment or a licence for that product. This call does not purchase a feed; prices and record counts are in the response and are read live.
name: drinkedin_list_data_products

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

records_available.description: A count, the string unavailable, or null for a non-row product
